text: deseti ādikallāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsetīti . tenahi tvaṃ māṇavaka mama vacanena samaṇaṃ udāyiṃ nimantehi svātanāya bhattenāti evaṃ bhotīti #1 ma. yu. udāyī . evamuparipi . 2-4 ma. yu. verahaccāni ... . evamuparipi . #3 yu. so . kho so māṇavako verahañcānigottāya brāhmaṇiyā paṭissutvā yenāyasmā udāyi tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ etadavoca adhivāsetu kira bhavaṃ udāyi amhākaṃ ācariyāya 1 verahañcānigottāya brāhmaṇiyā svātanāya bhattanti . adhivāsesi kho āyasmā udāyi tuṇhībhāvena . atha kho āyasmā
